rationale.question: Can lagged broad-market return-per-reported-activity stress provide a complementary complete participation policy in an expert pool?
rationale.law: At each genuine NYSE month endD, use273SPYdaily observations endingD-1, requiring274adjusted close levels. For each ending day divide absolute adjusted close simple return by reported raw_close times reported share volume. Compare the latest21-observation mean with the immediately preceding nonoverlapping252-observation mean. Round their relative ratio to12decimals; strictly greater than1 requests98%actualBIL, otherwise equal six-style core totaling98%. Retain2%idle cash and original execution.
rationale.choice: One declared month-versus-prior-year comparison and one-session information lag, not a threshold/window/inversion/asset sweep. Equality and rounded equality retain core. An undefined or degenerate reference is fatal, not risk-off evidence.
rationale.distinct_from_prior_art: Prior activity momentum weights signed fund returns by activity and changes within-core ranks on a parent policy. This is absolute broad SPY return per reported activity, with nonoverlapping windows, used for full core-versus-bill participation. It neither replays that policy nor retunes a failed volatility threshold or parent budget.
rationale.proxy_limits: Reported close times reported share volume is a closing-valuation activity proxy, not executed dollars, net flows, constituent turnover, bid-ask spread, market depth or true price impact. ETF creation/redemption, distributions, corporate actions, price/volume units and volatility can confound it; shared market exposure does not create independent risk or alpha.
rationale.information_clock: The last numerical input is D-1. This declared lag is not proof of every historical first publication, revision-free PIT or fund-methodology continuity. Reuse original admitted OHLCV and all original source gates without replacing prices, changing RF, filling gaps or requesting new quotes.
rationale.literature: Amihud2002, Illiquidity and stock returns: cross-section and time-series effects, DOI10.1016/S1386-4181(01)00024-6 motivates return-per-activity measurement only. This ETF proxy and monthly participation law are not its stock-level replication or imported empirical conclusion; Crossref bibliographic metadata was independently retained.
rationale.future_finance: Preparation computes synthetic outcomes and input-quality readiness only, not a real historical indicator, opinion, target, shadow, account or performance. A separate exact financial implementation and actual registration/publication must precede real outputs and original four-path accounting. Actual family participation, technical admission and deliberate pool inclusion require later evidence.
rationale.bias: 264 prior completions are exposed. A future old-dated opinion assumes counterfactual availability of a policy introduced now, not a backdated actual source or independent prospective validation.
